incidents.name: Degraded performance for Claude Fable 5.2
incidents.message: The issue affecting claude.ai has been resolved. Impact occurred from 02:20 PT / 10:20 UTC to 02:40 PT / 10:40 UTC.

incidents.name: Elevated errors for multiple models
incidents.message: We have identified an issue which affected Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Mythos 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 from 20:52 PT on November 24 / 04:52 UTC on November 25 to 21:16 PT on November 24 / 05:16 UTC on November 25, resulting in elevated errors. This issue has been resolved.

incidents.name: Elevated errors for Claude Haiku 5.5
incidents.message: The issue affecting Claude services has been resolved. Impact occurred from 09:09 PT / 17:09 UTC to 09:27 PT / 17:27 UTC.

incidents.name: Claude for Microsoft 365 add-in missing for some users
incidents.message: Our upstream provider has applied a mitigation for the issue that caused the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account, and we are monitoring for recovery. If Claude is still missing, try adding it again from Microsoft Marketplace, or use the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

incidents.name: Claude Meetings auto-join limited on the Team plan
incidents.message: Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls normally. Enterprise and Team customers can add Claude to calls. Auto-join is available for all Enterprise customers and some Team customers. We'll continue rolling out auto-join to additional Team customers in the coming days.
